title: Duetto
metaDescription: 92 diamonds · 38.08 ct total — 46 round brilliants alternating with 46 emerald cuts, stone to stone in 18K white gold. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Two cuts. Neither one louder than the other. The emerald holds its light quietly — clean lines, parallel faces, still. The round throws it in every direction at once. In white gold, they alternate without interruption from the first stone to the last. No center stone. No graduation. No hierarchy. The pattern is the point.

specs.label: Stones
specs.body: 92 diamonds total · 38.08 carats · 46 round brilliants (14.67 ct) alternating with 46 emerald cuts (23.41 ct) · continuous from first stone to last.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Stone-to-stone throughout. 18K white gold. No center stone. No graduation. No hierarchy — the alternating pattern runs uninterrupted end to end.
